test_title: PYST 39: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 14 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In 2025, which institution was directed by the National Green Tribunal to assess the ultraviolet sewage treatment technology?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IIT Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **2025**, the **National Green Tribunal (NGT)** issued a significant directive to the **Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Delhi** to conduct an expert assessment of **Ultraviolet (UV) radiation technology** used in **Sewage Treatment Plants (STPs)**.
 
• The primary objective of this assessment is to evaluate the **germicidal efficacy** of UV systems in neutralizing harmful pathogens, such as **fecal coliform**, which often persist in treated sewage water before it is discharged into rivers like the **Yamuna** and **Ganga**. ***Hence, the correct option is IIT Delhi.***
 
• The **NGT**, led by its **Chairperson**, emphasized the need for a scientific audit because many **STPs** across India were failing to meet the **permissible limits** of bacterial contamination despite using UV disinfection.
 
• The study by **IIT Delhi** is expected to provide a comparative analysis between **UV treatment** and other disinfection methods like **chlorination** or **ozonation** to determine the most environmentally sustainable and cost-effective solution for **wastewater management**.
 
• This directive is part of a broader judicial push to refine **environmental standards** and ensure that technical specifications of **urban infrastructure** align with the **Right to a Clean Environment** under **Article 21** of the **Constitution of India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Green Tribunal (NGT):**
 
 
• Established on **18th October 2010** under the **National Green Tribunal Act, 2010**, it is a specialized body for the effective and expeditious disposal of cases relating to **environmental protection** and conservation of forests.
 
• The **Principal Bench** of the **NGT** is located in **New Delhi**, with regional benches in **Bhopal, Pune, Kolkata, and Chennai**.
 
• It is not bound by the procedure laid down under the **Code of Civil Procedure, 1908**, but is guided by principles of **natural justice**.
 
 
 
• **UV Sewage Treatment Technology:**
 
 
• **UV-C radiation** (specifically wavelengths between **200 and 280 nanometers**) is used to disrupt the **DNA** and **RNA** of microorganisms, preventing them from reproducing.
 
• It is considered a **chemical-free** alternative to chlorine, ensuring that no harmful **disinfection by-products (DBPs)** are introduced into the water ecosystem.
 
• However, the efficiency of **UV systems** is highly dependent on **water turbidity**; suspended solids can shield bacteria from the light, necessitating the expert review ordered in **2025**.
 
 
 
• **IIT Delhi's Role in Policy:**
 
 
• As one of the **Institutes of Eminence**, **IIT Delhi** frequently collaborates with the **Ministry of Jal Shakti** and the **Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB)** on projects like the **National Mission for Clean Ganga (NMCG)**.
 
• The institution’s **Department of Civil Engineering** houses specialized labs for **Environmental Engineering**, making it the preferred technical advisor for **NGT** mandates regarding **sanitation** and **pollution control**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Water Quality Standards:** According to **CPCB** guidelines, the **Fecal Coliform** level in treated sewage should ideally be less than **100 MPN/100ml** for safe discharge into water bodies.
 
• **River Rejuvenation:** The **NGT’s** 2025 order is a critical step in the **Yamuna Rejuvenation Plan**, aiming to stop the "frothing" caused by untreated surfactants and high bacterial loads in **Delhi** and **Agra**.
 
• **Technological Challenges:** While **IIT Kanpur** and **IIT Bombay** also conduct water research, the **NGT** chose **IIT Delhi** due to its proximity to the **Yamuna River STPs** and its ongoing technical monitoring of **Delhi’s** drainage systems.

43:T
